meaning: The name-entry buffer is three initials. INTLHS holds the horizontal display coord of each of the three initials being entered during TAKE INITIALS (W3DSUP.MAC:4064); its .BYTE lists exactly three coords, one per initial. Reused by the port as MC_INITIALS_LEN over @shared/name-entry.

source.verbatim: INTLHS:	.BYTE 82,78,6E		;HORIZ COORD OF 3 INITIALS BEING ENTERED

meaning: The initials charset is the 26 letters A-Z. GETINI cycles the current letter over 26 codes (LDA I,26. wraps the index at 0, W3DSUP.MAC:4128; CMP I,27. wraps at the top, :4132) and forms the glyph by adding the ASCII A offset (ADC I,41 = 0x41 = A, :4158/:4172). The ROM trackball cursor cycler and its blank 27th slot are DELIBERATELY not ported (the fleet keyboard ruling, joust jt10-7); the port takes A-Z via @shared/name-entry.stepNameEntry.

Name entry aborts on EITHER trigger, discarding the entry with no ladder insert: a start-switch press (BNE ABORT, W3DSUP.MAC:4076) or a timeout (IFEQ ;TOO MUCH TIME? -> JMP ABORT, :4086-:4088; the countdown seeds UCVTAB = 0x84, :RESET TIMEOUT TO 30 SEC, :4180). The port models both as abortNameEntry -> attract, buffer cleared, table unchanged.

source.verbatim: BNE ABORT		;ABORT IF EITHER START SWITCH PRESS
